title: Extract the duplicated money formatting
objective: One formatMoney(cents, currency) in src/money.mjs replaces the three copies of the formatting code
requirements: src/money.mjs exports formatMoney(cents, currency), returning e.g. '€3.50' or '-$0.05'
invoice.mjs and receipt.mjs import formatMoney from "./money.mjs" and no longer format amounts themselves
every existing output string stays byte-for-byte the same

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the existing inputs, when invoiceLine, invoiceTotal and receipt run, then their outputs are unchanged
Given formatMoney(-5, 'USD'), when called, then it returns '-$0.05'

plan: Record current outputs as a baseline
Use it in src/invoice.mjs and src/receipt.mjs
architectureDecisions: A new src/money.mjs module shared by invoice and receipt
repositoryFindings: invoice.mjs formats money twice and receipt.mjs once, identically
assumptions: a negative amount puts the sign before the currency symbol, as today
